description: Switch the whole project to another built-in art style. Every shot is rebuilt from the new style's own place, light and lead character: actions, cast, scenery and keyframes go; texts and lengths stay. If the project already has work, the first call returns needsConfirm; ask, then call with confirm: true. One undo step for the person. For one of the person's own styles use use_style; to start fresh use new_project.

confirm.description: true only after the person agreed to rebuild the shots.

name: set_style
